description: Source code for electronic throttle control module, including PID control, PWM management, and configuration functions for an automotive electronic throttle body (ETB).

classes.name: Pid
classes.description: PID controller class used for throttle control.

classes.name: OutputPin
classes.description: Class representing a GPIO output pin.

methods.name: etbThread
methods.description: Main control loop for electronic throttle, managing PID, PWM, and auto-tuning.

methods.name: setThrottleDutyCycle
methods.description: Manually sets throttle duty cycle without PID control.

methods.name: showEthInfo
methods.description: Displays current electronic throttle status and configuration.

methods.name: setEtbPFactor
methods.description: Sets proportional factor for throttle PID.

methods.name: setEtbIFactor
methods.description: Sets integral factor for throttle PID.

methods.name: setEtbDFactor
methods.description: Sets derivative factor for throttle PID.

methods.name: setDefaultEtbParameters
methods.description: Resets throttle parameters to default values.

methods.name: isETBRestartNeeded
methods.description: Checks if hardware configuration change requires restart.

methods.name: onConfigurationChangeElectronicThrottleCallback
methods.description: Handles configuration changes related to electronic throttle.

methods.name: startETBPins
methods.description: Initializes PWM and control pins for ETB.

methods.name: setDefaultEtbBiasCurve
methods.description: Resets ETB bias curve to default.

methods.name: initElectronicThrottle
methods.description: Initializes electronic throttle control system, registers console commands, and starts control thread.
